summary: Noah Holdings filed a Form 6-K furnishing its Hong Kong Exchange monthly return on movements in securities for the month ended October 31, 2026. Issued shares were unchanged at 343,228,815 with zero treasury shares, and authorized share capital held at USD 50,000. No options were granted, exercised, or cancelled during the month, and the company confirmed compliance with the 25% minimum public float threshold under Main Board Rule 13.32B. This is a routine HKEX housekeeping disclosure carried on a US Form 6-K; no transaction, stake, price, or shareholder action is present.
